messages:
Lina Park: Quick idea 11111111 Propose a lightweight two-path DP intake: 'fast-track' for high-fit customers and 'discovery' for varied feedback. Thoughts?
Diego Marques: 👍 Sounds promising. How do you define high-fit?
Lina Park: Scorecard with five fields: company fit (20), product integration depth (25), regulatory impact (-15..0), probe quality (30), willingness for check-ins (25). Fast-track >=80. Discovery 50-79.
Ava Nguyen: Will the probe be public? we should avoid guiding answers. Short freeform look good.
Lina Park: Sample probe (short):
```
1) One-line product goal
2) Example prompt + expected output (1-3 lines)
3) Rough monthly token range
4) Any data/sensitivity flags?
5) Willingness for 30m weekly syncs? Y/N
```
Tom Brewer: Ops question: SLA on reviewing probes and issuing invites?
Lina Park: Proposal: discovery: triage 72h, decision 7 business days. Fast-track: triage 24h, decision 48h (or 72h if engineering time needed).
Diego Marques: Incentives? credits, partner spotlight, engineering hours?
Ava Nguyen: For startups, credits + co-marketing works. For enterprise, dedicated onboarding and sandbox access is better.
Lina Park: Tiered incentives: discovery: $300 credits + feedback badge. Fast-track: $1500 credit OR 8 hrs onboarding + co-marketing slot.
intake-bot: Reminder: add accepted partners to DP onboarding sheet: https://go/reddp/onboard
Tom Brewer: Rollout gates: require 8 active partners per path, baseline usage (>=1k tokens/day or agreed), and no eval regressions.
Diego Marques: Add a small holdout prompt set from partners to catch regressions. Also quick NPS pulse at week 3.
Ava Nguyen: Who will own weekly check-ins? I can own discovery cohort for first 6 weeks, Tom can run fast-track?
Tom Brewer: I can take fast-track for 6 weeks. Will reserve 2x onboarding slots/week.
Lina Park: Ops will publish onboarding checklist (preflight, probe review, kickoff templates, follow-up survey). Tom, Diego 1 please confirm capacity constraints by EOD.
Diego Marques: Risks from my side: probe fatigue, biased sample towards low-feedback enterprises, and security triage slowdowns.
Ava Nguyen: I'll note product risks: scope creep in asks, unclear success metrics from partners. Suggest a 3-week mini-eval: signal = partner reports 2/3 core flows improved.
Tom Brewer: Ops risk: queue growth > reserved slots. mitigations: limit fast-track to 10 per month, overflow to discovery.
Lina Park: Great. I'll update the intake form: hidden "priority_override" flag, dropdown for intended SLA tier, and security-impact tag for pre-screen. Will push tomorrow AM. :rocket:
Diego Marques: Thanks. Adding my top 3 risks in the sheet now.
Ava Nguyen: Added.
Tom Brewer: Ops checklist draft will be in #product-docs by EOD.
Lina Park: Thanks team 1 pushing updated form + doc tomorrow morning.
